## English

## Affected document

Link the document and section.

## Problem and proposed correction

Describe the issue and expected wording or behavior.

## Evidence

Provide sources and explain uncertainty. Do not include personal data, secrets, or confidential rights evidence.

## Impact

Explain who is affected and any relevant accessibility concern.
